                      Details

                      Hand review · 2026-11-06 (deep dive 07:30 UTC)

                      What it does
                      Borrow against NVDA stock tokens into a private pool, spend privately, let AI agents pay on credit. Not for US persons.
                      Unique?
                      Rare mix (private borrowing + agent credit on stock tokens), built from known parts (Morpho, x402, ZK proofs).
                      In use?
                      No outside users yet: every pool transaction is their own operator's; 0 borrows, 0 credit lines, 0 bonds (on-chain, 6 Nov).
                      How it makes money
                      None yet: the paid AI API is a demo model and its payments are 'verified, not settled'.
                      Token today
                      Only an operator bond, and no bonds posted yet. No buyback, burn or revenue share (their words).
                      Team
                      Anonymous. X made 28 Oct, domain 29-30 Oct, token 3 Nov, contracts 5 Nov.
                      Watch for
                      Outside wallets borrowing · bonds posted · npm SDK published · real AI models on the gateway · public code

                                                        Hand review · 2026-11-06 (deep dive 07:30 UTC)

                                                        What it does
                                                        Borrow against NVDA stock tokens into a private pool, spend privately, let AI agents pay on credit. Not for US persons.
                                                        Unique?
                                                        Rare mix (private borrowing + agent credit on stock tokens), built from known parts (Morpho, x402, ZK proofs).
                                                        In use?
                                                        No outside users yet: every pool transaction is their own operator's; 0 borrows, 0 credit lines, 0 bonds (on-chain, 6 Nov).
                                                        How it makes money
                                                        None yet: the paid AI API is a demo model and its payments are 'verified, not settled'.
                                                        Token today
                                                        Only an operator bond, and no bonds posted yet. No buyback, burn or revenue share (their words).
                                                        Team
                                                        Anonymous. X made 28 Oct, domain 29-30 Oct, token 3 Nov, contracts 5 Nov.
                                                        Watch for
                                                        Outside wallets borrowing · bonds posted · npm SDK published · real AI models on the gateway · public code

                                                                                                                            What it does
                                                                                                                            AI assistant app that writes code, runs tasks, and builds and hosts apps. Pays for services from its own wallet.
                                                                                                                            Unique?
                                                                                                                            Partly. The pieces exist elsewhere; having all of them in one app with a built-in wallet is rare. Open source, so easy to copy.
                                                                                                                            Scalable?
                                                                                                                            Software yes (fast, light). Business unproven: 2-person team, paid servers, rich rivals.
                                                                                                                            Narrative fit
                                                                                                                            Strong: AI agents that pay for things. Weak Robinhood Chain link: only the token lives here.
                                                                                                                            How it makes money
                                                                                                                            Subscriptions ($20/month), a cut on AI models it resells, and hosting.
                                                                                                                            Token today
                                                                                                                            Does nothing yet. Buybacks and paying with LETRO aren't switched on.
                                                                                                                            Watch for
                                                                                                                            Buybacks starting · X followers (193 now) · team's last token fell 83% · unclear where its cheap AI prices come from (could be the team's AILE sharing market)
